account.account_id: a unique identifier for each bank account
account.district_id: the identifier for the district associated with the account
account.frequency: the frequency at which account statements are issued
account.date: the date when the account was created
card.card_id: unique identifier for each card issued by the bank
card.disp_id: identifier linking the card to a specific account holder
card.type: category of the card indicating its level or benefits
card.issued: date when the card was issued to the account holder
client.client_id: a unique identifier for each client
client.birth_date: the birth date of the client
client.district_id: the identifier for the district where the client resides
disp.disp_id: unique identifier for each client-account relationship record
disp.client_id: unique identifier for the client associated with the account
disp.account_id: unique identifier for the account linked to the client
disp.type: role of the client in relation to the account
district.a3: region where the district is located
district.a4: number of inhabitants (population) of the district
district.a5: number of municipalities with fewer than 500 inhabitants
district.a6: number of municipalities with 500 to 1999 inhabitants
district.a7: number of municipalities with 2000 to 9999 inhabitants
district.a8: number of municipalities with 10000 or more inhabitants
district.a9: number of cities in the district
district.a10: ratio of urban inhabitants in the district
district.a12: unemployment rate in the district for 1995
district.a13: unemployment rate in the district for 1996
district.a15: number of crimes committed in the district in 1995
district.a16: number of crimes committed in the district in 1996
loan.loan_id: unique identifier for each loan issued by the financial institution
loan.account_id: unique identifier for the account associated with the loan
loan.date: date on which the loan was issued
loan.amount: total principal amount of the loan issued
loan.duration: number of months over which the loan is to be repaid
loan.payments: monthly payment amount required to repay the loan
loan.status: current status of the loan in terms of repayment
order.order_id: unique identifier for each order transaction
order.account_id: identifier for the account initiating the order
order.bank_to: code of the bank receiving the order
order.account_to: identifier for the account receiving the order
order.amount: monetary value of the order transaction
order.k_symbol: transaction type or purpose code for the order
trans.trans_id: unique identifier for each transaction record
trans.account_id: identifier for the account associated with the transaction
trans.operation: specific operation type of the transaction
trans.bank: code representing the bank involved in the transaction
trans.account: account number associated with the transaction
